---
title: "Hierarchy Diagram"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)

con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
hier <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT ID, Name, Parent FROM Sample_Hierarchy")
dbDisconnect(con)

build_tree <- function(df, parent_id = NA_integer_, level = 0) {
  roots <- df[is.na(df$Parent) & is.na(parent_id) | df$Parent == parent_id, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(roots) == 0) return(character())

  lines <- character()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(roots))) {
    row <- roots[i, ]
    lines <- c(lines, paste0(strrep("  ", level), "- ", row$Name, " (", row$ID, ")"))
    lines <- c(lines, build_tree(df, row$ID, level + 1))
  }

  lines
}
```

# Hierarchy Diagram

```{r hierarchy-tree, echo=FALSE}
if (nrow(hier) > 0) {
  cat(paste(build_tree(hier), collapse = "\n"))
} else {
  cat("No hierarchy records found.")
}
```
